description:

description:

In 2012, 26-year-old Timothy Rambo Ramsey is killed in a drive-by shooting, but the investigation yields little evidence, and the case goes cold for six years; when detectives re-examine the evidence, they uncover a violent feud between two men.

description:

title: American Godfathers: The Five Families
description:
S01 E01 — Death of the Old Rules
Follows the American Mafia from their early development in New York City neighborhoods; how public violence, involvement in the drug trade, and appearances at government hearings affect their operations and conflict with their code of honor.

title: American Godfathers: The Five Families
description:
S01 E02 — Rise of the New Dons
Focusing on the conflict between the families' old guard and a new generation of younger, American-born, mobsters willing to defy the authority of the bosses and the long-established rules in order to fulfill their own ambitions.

title: American Godfathers: The Five Families
description:
S01 E03 — The Last Don
How a more aggressive commitment by law enforcement to eradicate the mafia forces the families to find creative ways to stay in business and out of jail; it's not as easy as it's been in the past and some are willing to throw it all away.

title: Mobsters
description:
S02 E07 — Mob's Greatest Hits
Six of the most notorious mafia killings of all time and the effects they had on organized crime.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E09 — Clear and Present Dangers
ATF Agent Scott Perala takes down a career criminal, while FBI Agent Robert Wittman investigates a man pretending to be a sheik selling fake artwork; Broward County detective, Cesar Morales, stops a string of robberies.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E02 — Breaking the Iceman
ATF undercover agent Dominick Polifrone aims to pass himself off as a mobster to stop the Iceman serial killer; Bergen County undercover detective Carlos James poses as a gang member to disrupt a treacherous plot against a woman's ex.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E08 — Birds and Bricks
NYPD Officer turned undercover agent Jerry Speziale finds that a bullet changes the trajectory of his career; Fish and Wildlife Service's special agent Ed Newcomer investigates the senseless hawk killings in California.

title: Undercover: Caught on Tape
description:
S01 E03 — A World of Hurt
In the cities of Daytona and Cocoa, ATF Special Agent Perala's life is threatened when suspects turn the tables on him; in New York, a tipster claims that a man awaiting trial is planning an attack on his alleged rape victim before she can testify.

title: Stadium Lockup
description:
S01 E01 — Code of Conduct
Protecting the stadium are highly trained men and women from law enforcement, private security teams, and medics; the security team breaks up several brawls over unruly behavior and seat disputes.

title: Stadium Lockup
description:
S01 E02 — Only in Cleveland
The security team stays on high alert over a potential influencer interference, intercedes in a heated dispute between two men, handles an intense incident with a highly intoxicated female, and escorts an unruly fan off the premises.

title: Stadium Lockup
description:
S01 E03 — Bitter Rivals
Tensions are at an all-time high between these rivaling fans when a fight quickly erupts requiring multiple personnel to break it up.
